candidates.change_summary: Change the initialization of guesses[msg.sender].block from block.number + 1 to block.number (so lockInGuess sets block to the current block instead of next block).
Remove the requirement that msg.value equals 1 ether, allowing calls with different msg.value to set the guess and block.
After storing the guess, immediately clear guesses[msg.sender].block by setting it to 0 (so lockInGuess does not leave the expected block number), inserted statement after storing guess.
Change the initial require that ensures no existing guess to instead require that a guess already exists (inverting the guard), preventing new guesses but allowing overwrite only when one exists.
Move the require(msg.value == 1 ether) to after assignments so the state is changed before validating the payment amount.
Replace the line that computes answer to use the current blockhash (block.number) instead of the locked block, changing which hash is compared and thus settlement outcome.
Replace the line that clears the stored block number to instead clear the stored guess (setting guess to zero), changing post-settlement state and potential future behavior.
Replace the transfer amount to 1 ether instead of 2 ether, changing the funds transferred on successful settlement.
Insert an extra require that the guessed value is nonzero before proceeding, preventing settlement if guess was zeroed.
Replace the comparison direction to require(block.number >= guesses[msg.sender].block) allowing settlement in the same block as the locked block, altering when settle can succeed.
